alex_chang: Hey team — I tried to redeem the promo code I got in the partner email (FREEYEAR-REDWOOD) and the checkout says "Promo code invalid or expired". I can see the code active in the partner portal. Can someone check?
megan_support: Sorry about that, Alex. Can you paste the exact code as you entered it (feel free to redact part)? Also the account email you used?
alex_chang: Sure — I entered: FREEYEAR-REDWOOD. (I copied from the PDF the partner sent). Account: alex+test@acme.com. Request id: req_2026_0451_99321
megan_support: Thanks. Reproducing on my side now. If you don't mind, can you try typing it manually instead of pasting? quick sanity check.
alex_chang: Typed it manually and it worked! It accepted the code and applied the free year. Weird.
megan_support: OK that confirms it's a copy issue. Sending logs to eng: promo-service returned: "invalid_signature: signature verification failed" for code payload when code included trailing '.' character.
promo-bot: Audit log: promo_redeem_attempt by alex+test@acme.com — method=checkout, code_entered="FREEYEAR-REDWOOD.", result=FORBIDDEN (invalid_signature), request=req_2026_0451_99321
rachel_engineer: Thanks for the heads up. Quick explanation: some partner PDFs append a period at end of sentences; when users copy the code they sometimes pick up trailing punctuation. Our signature verification is strict and the extra character changes the HMAC payload.
megan_support: Is that something we can defensively handle server-side?
rachel_engineer: Yes — we should trim whitespace but also strip common trailing punctuation like .,;:—when validating codes. Quick patch: sanitize input by trimming and removing trailing punctuation characters before verification. I'll open a small PR to sanitize and run tests.
diego_billing: In the meantime, Alex — since you had trouble, we'll apply the free year manually to your account as a backup and log a note. Also adding +7 days to the trial for the friction.
alex_chang: Appreciate it, thanks!
rachel_engineer: Follow-up action items: 1) hotfix to sanitize code inputs (patch ready, will ship to staging today) 2) update partner docs/emailed code examples to include a code block and note: "copy as-is, avoid trailing punctuation" 3) billing manual credit applied and note in account.
megan_support: I've filed a support ticket for the partner ops team to update the PDF template. Ticket #SUP-8421.
promo-bot: Rule triggered: promo_input_sanitization_issue — created task TASK-554.
diego_billing: Manual credit applied (txn id pm_2026_0612_77). Confirmed +7 days trial extension.
alex_chang: Confirmed I see the extension and the manual credit. Thanks everyone :rocket: :heart: 
megan_support: Marking resolved for support. Will monitor if we see more instances and loop in partner ops. If anything else pops up, reply here. :thumbsup:
